text:
lucas: Morning — first day checklist hiccup. Okta shows me active but Gmail app on my phone says account doesn't exist. Drive doc from People Ops loads though. Anyone? @dina

dina: Welcome Lucas! :wave: Drive visible means GSuite account provisioned. What error do you see in the Gmail app?

lucas: It just says 'No account found for this email'. I tried removing and re-adding the account.

it-help: Hi Lucas — sometimes mobile SSO token hasn't propagated. Two quick things: (1) try removing the app and reinstalling, (2) try signing in via Safari to trigger SSO. If that fails, we can force a resync.

lucas: Reinstalled, still same. Safari sign-in worked and redirected to Okta, asked me to enroll MFA. I enrolled Okta Verify. Now Gmail app shows account.

dina: Great! One more: if you need SSH access, add your pubkey to the 1Password onboarding item "SSH Keys - onboarding" and mention @devops. Your onboarding buddy is @ashley.

lucas: Added pubkey. Thanks all! :smile:
